decision.reason: [ev-a907ed2193a8] says only that "terminationGracePeriod RBAC permissions" were added as a bug fix. terminationGracePeriod is not an RBAC resource or verb, so it can't be the name of an rbac-permission subject, which has to be resource[/verb]. The evidence doesn't say which resource, verb, API group or role was granted. The render validator also couldn't see the permission with chart defaults. To spell the subject, we need the RBAC diff from PR #6538 or the rendered ClusterRole/Role rules from before and after.
